# Proverbs 30 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Words-of Agur son-of Jakeh, the-oracle. Declares the-man to-Ithiel, to-Ithiel and-Ucal:

**2** Surely I [am]-more-brutish than-[any]-man, and-understanding-of mankind is-not for-me.

**3** And-I-have-not-learned wisdom, and-knowledge-of [the]-Holy-One I-do-not-know.

**4** Who has-ascended [to]-heaven and-descended? Who has-gathered [the]-wind in-his-fists? Who has-wrapped [the]-waters in-a-garment? Who has-established all [the]-ends-of [the]-earth? What [is]-his-name, and-what [is the]-name-of his-son — if you-know?

**5** Every word-of God [is]-refined; a-shield He [is] to-those-taking-refuge in-Him.

**6** Do-not-add to-His-words, lest He-rebuke-you and-you-be-found-a-liar.

**7** Two-things I-ask from-you; do-not-withhold from-me before I-die:

**8** Vanity and-a-word-of falsehood put-far from-me; poverty and-riches do-not-give-me — feed-me [with]-bread-of my-portion,

**9** Lest I-be-full and-deny and-say, 'Who [is] YHWH?' Or-lest I-become-poor and-steal, and-profane [the]-name-of my-God.

**10** Do-not-slander a-servant to his-master, lest he-curse-you and-you-be-found-guilty.

**11** A-generation — its-father it-curses, and-its-mother it-does-not-bless.

**12** A-generation — pure in-its-[own]-eyes, but-from-its-filth it-is-not-washed.

**13** A-generation — how-lofty its-eyes, and-its-eyelids are-raised!

**14** A-generation — swords [are] its-teeth, and-knives its-jaw-teeth, to-devour [the]-poor from-[the]-earth and-[the]-needy from-among mankind.

**15** The-leech has-two daughters: 'Give! Give!' Three-things are-not-satisfied; four do-not-say 'Enough!':

**16** Sheol, and-a-womb restrained, earth not-satisfied [with]-water, and-fire [that]-does-not-say 'Enough!'

**17** An-eye mocking a-father and-despising to-obey a-mother — the-ravens-of [the]-valley will-pluck-it-out, and-[the]-young-of [the]-eagle will-eat-it.

**18** Three-things are-too-wonderful for-me, and-four I-do-not-know:

**19** [The]-way-of [the]-eagle in-the-heavens, [the]-way-of a-serpent upon a-rock, [the]-way-of a-ship in-[the]-heart-of [the]-sea, and-[the]-way-of a-man with-a-young-woman.

**20** So [is the]-way-of a-woman adulterous: she-eats and-wipes her-mouth and-says, 'I-have-not-done iniquity.'

**21** Under three-things [the]-earth trembles, and-under four it-cannot bear-up:

**22** Under a-servant when-he-reigns, and-a-fool when-he-is-satisfied [with]-bread,

**23** Under a-hated-woman when-she-is-married, and-a-maidservant when-she-dispossesses her-mistress.

**24** Four-things [are the]-small-ones-of [the]-earth, and-they [are]-wiser-than-wise:

**25** The-ants — a-people not strong, and-they-prepare in-the-summer their-food;

**26** The-rock-badgers — a-people not mighty, and-they-set in-the-rock their-house;

**27** A-king there-is-not for-the-locusts, and-they-go-out dividing all-of-them;

**28** A-lizard with-hands you-can-seize, and-it [is] in-[the]-palaces-of a-king.

**29** Three-things [are] those-doing-well-of step, and-four [are]-those-doing-well-of going:

**30** A-lion, mightiest among-beasts and-does-not-turn-back before anyone;

**31** A-greyhound, a-he-goat also, and-a-king [against]-whom there-is-no-rising.

**32** If you-have-been-foolish in-exalting-yourself, and-if you-have-plotted — [put your]-hand to-[your]-mouth!

**33** For pressing milk brings-forth butter, and-pressing [the]-nose brings-forth blood, and-pressing anger brings-forth strife.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **30:1-4**: Agur's confession of ignorance — unique in Proverbs. Some read vv. 2-3 as genuine humility; others as ironic. The rhetorical questions of v. 4 echo Job 38.

- **30:8-9**: The prayer for 'neither poverty nor riches' — the only explicit prayer in Proverbs. Remarkable for its moderation and self-knowledge.

- **30:18-19**: Numerical saying (3/4 pattern). The four 'ways' share the quality of being trackless — leaving no visible trace. The mystery of movement without evidence.

— EMET
